The most important organelles of a cell

Cell organelles are specialized, often membrane-bound structures within eukaryotic cells that perform specific functions, similar to organs in a body. Key organelles include the nucleus (genetic storage), mitochondria (energy production), ribosomes (protein synthesis), and the endoplasmic reticulum/Golgi apparatus (transport and modification).

ATP: the molecular currency

Adenosine triphosphate (ATP) is a nucleoside triphosphate that provides free energy of approximately 58 kJ/mol to drive and support many processes in living cells, such as muscle contraction, nerve impulse propagation, and chemical synthesis.

Is Turbo AI free to use?
Yes! Turbo AI offers a generous free tier that includes note generation, flashcards, and quizzes. You can upgrade to unlock unlimited features and advanced AI capabilities.
Can I edit the notes after they're generated?
Yes! We have a full Google Docs style editor you can use to add and customize your notes.
Does it work for STEM subjects with formulas and diagrams?
Absolutely! Turbo AI handles math formulas, chemical equations, physics diagrams, and code snippets. It recognizes and preserves formatting for technical content, making it perfect for engineering, pre-med, and science majors.
Does it work on mobile devices?
Yes, Turbo AI works seamlessly across all devices - web, tablet, and mobile. Your notes sync automatically so you can study anywhere, anytime.
